content.short: BitGo provides institutional digital asset custody, portfolio management tools, and APIs for developers.
content.description: BitGo delivers institutional digital asset custody, trading, and financial management services for enterprises. Traders can securely store private wallets and custody credentials with BitGo, and benefit from enterprise-grade security and controls. Developers can extend BitGo’s functionality to their own applications by using its APIs and webhooks, enabling programmatic access to custody, trading, and related financial workflow features within their systems.
content.meta: BitGo is an institutional digital asset custody, trading, and financial management service. Discover BitGo and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
